title: Sanger Tree of Life HMW DNA Extraction: Automated MagAttract v.3
author: Graeme Oatley
materials: For PowerMashed samples (weight less than 25 mg):

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the lysis buffer master mix.

steps.title: Sample Homogenization and Lysis
steps.instruction: Homogenize the sample in lysis buffer and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Transfer a 25 mg cryoprepped/bead beaten sample into a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube and hold on dry ice to keep frozen.
Add 374 µL of the lysis buffer master mix to the sample.
Homogenize the sample and master mix by gently pipetting 10 times with a wide-bore pipette tip.
Transfer the entire contents of the BioMasher tube to a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube using a wide-bore tip.

Alternatively, transfer sample into a 1.5 mL BioMasher II tube, add 374 µL lysis buffer, and disrupt using the Diagnocine PowerMasher II tissue disruptor and BioMasher pestle until no large pieces remain or sample cannot be disrupted further.
Centrifuge all sample tubes briefly and incubate on the heat block at 25 ºC for 2 hours.

steps.title: Prepare KingFisher Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare and label the plates for the automated extraction.

substeps.instruction: While samples are lysing, label nine 1 mL 96-well deep-well KingFisher™ plates.
Fill the number of wells required for the number of samples in each plate.

steps.title: Transfer Lysate to Sample Plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the processed lysate into the KingFisher sample plate.

substeps.instruction: Remove sample tubes from the heat block and briefly centrifuge to spin down.
Using a wide-bore pipette tip set to 380 µL, transfer lysate from the sample tubes to individual wells in the sample plate, avoiding large pieces of debris.

steps.title: Run DNA Extraction Protocol
steps.instruction: Execute the automated DNA extraction on the KingFisher™ Apex.

substeps.instruction: Load the filled plates onto the instrument following on-screen instructions.
Select the required DNA extraction protocol from the protocol list and press the play button.
Allow the protocol to run automatically (approximately 40 minutes).
Follow on-screen instructions to remove plates; retain the Tip Plate containing the tip comb for future steps.

steps.title: DNA Elution
steps.instruction: Allow DNA to elute overnight and perform bead collection.

substeps.instruction: Seal the Elution Plate with a plate seal and leave overnight at room temperature to allow the DNA to elute.
The following morning, remove the plate seal and return to the KingFisher™ Apex.
Load the Tip Plate and Elution Plate as prompted and run the 'bead collection' protocol.
Once the bead collection protocol completes (approximately 5 minutes), follow on-screen instructions to remove the plates.

steps.title: Clean Eluate and Prepare for SPRI
steps.instruction: Ensure the eluate is free of beads and prepare for the 0.45X SPRI.

substeps.instruction: Inspect the Elution Plate for magnetic beads. If beads remain, transfer the sample to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, place on a magnetic rack for 5 minutes, and collect the clear eluate using a wide-bore pipette tip before returning it to the original well.
Set up the KingFisher™ plates for the 0.45X SPRI.

steps.title: Run 0.45X SPRI Protocol
steps.instruction: Perform the 0.45X SPRI cleanup on the KingFisher™ Apex.

substeps.instruction: The Elution Plate now serves as the 'Sample Plate' for the 0.45X SPRI.
Load the filled plates onto the instrument following on-screen instructions.
Select the required 0.45X SPRI protocol from the protocol list and press the play button.
Allow the protocol to run automatically (approximately 50 minutes).
Follow on-screen instructions to remove plates once the protocol is complete.

steps.title: Final Recovery and Storage
steps.instruction: Recover the final DNA and store.

substeps.instruction: Using a wide-bore pipette tip, transfer 130 µL of eluate from the elution plate into microcentrifuge tubes.
Store the DNA at 4 ºC.
Perform the required QC to determine quantity and quality of the extracted DNA.
